title: Hujr e Ismaeel
introduction:
HUJR-E-ISMAEEL

It is at a distance from the area between Northern and western pillar. There are graves of Ismaeel (a), his respected mother Hajra (s.a.) and many prophets other narrations prove that there are graves of many prophets around Kaba. We perform their Ziyarat also. It is recommended to wear Ehraam for Hajj-e-Tamatto in Hujr-e-Ismaeel on 'Mizab' below the canal. It is the place to supplicate, repent and seek mercy and desires.
